outputs.text: Nous avons reçu les résultats hier. Toutefois, les données sont encore incomplètes. Par conséquent, nous attendrons vendredi avant de conclure.

Across the three tested configurations, Cedar ranked first for throughput at 120 requests per second, Birch second at 95, and Ash third at 80; these measurements describe throughput, not latency. Cedar ran from 09:00 to 09:30 UTC and Birch from 09:15 to 09:45 UTC, overlapping for 15 minutes, while Ash ran from 10:00 to 10:30 UTC.
